selection_rules.command_profile_semantics: Canonical rationale and extension-family labels are copied from Louksna Section 27; runtime target assignments are a proposed compatibility layer and remain non-certifying.

audit_findings.finding: LOUKSNAMEJORADA.md formally specifies the 14 routes and canonical agent/engine bundles; these are preserved.
Existing planner routes command intent primarily to broad domain hints and does not model the full subdomain tree.
Existing task dispatch is PLAN_ONLY; broad task adapters are NOT_REGISTERED and peak RSS is unmeasured.
The existing casefold parser accepts undeclared case variations despite the source rule that aliases require explicit registration.
All ten compact infrastructure assets are mapped to subdomain consumers, but .7z presence is not executable integration.
The capability registry has the target nodes but marks operability UNVERIFIED.
